lots.what_it_is: Pair of glossy red moulded plastic mushroom table lamps, sold as 'PAIR OF MID-CENTURY MODERN STYLE TOUCH LAMPS'. Shape copies the Artemide Nesso (Giancarlo Mattioli, 1965-67). The title's 'style' and 'touch' strongly point to modern replicas: the genuine Nesso is 54 cm across, uses an E14 bulb with a cable switch, and is currently made in white and orange (Connox), while these appear smaller, red and touch-operated.
